description.value: Through magical manipulation of your genes, you can temporarily access the abilities of other species. You gain a 1st-level ancestry feat from a different ancestry than your own, chosen when you install this augmentation. You must meet the other prerequisites for this feat. By spending 1 hour and 500 credits' worth of genetic material, you can change this feat to a different one, which doesn't need to be from the same ancestry. Since the feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like another feat. In addition, you take on traits that are common in the chosen ancestry, such as antennae for shirren or cheek pouches for ysoki. These changes are vestigial and have no mechanical effect other than the feat you gained, but they're always noticeable and memorable.
